description: This file defines data models representing API responses, request bodies, and domain entities for a media rating platform. It includes data classes for likes, content, rating settings, and media items used within the Android frontend application.

classes.name: LikeResponse
classes.description: Represents the API response containing a 'LikeData' object.

classes.name: LikeData
classes.description: Encapsulates data about a like, including the like value, stars, timestamp, group ID, and optional group UID.

classes.name: LikePostBody
classes.description: Request body model for posting a like, containing group ID, like value, stars, and timestamp.

classes.name: ContentResponse
classes.description: Wraps a 'ContentGroupWrapper' which contains content group data.

classes.name: ContentGroupWrapper
classes.description: Contains a 'ContentGroup' object, acting as a container for content data.

classes.name: ContentGroup
classes.description: Holds information about content, including common attributes, poster image URL, and background image URL.

classes.name: ContentCommon
classes.description: Basic content details such as title.

classes.name: APAMetadataResponse
classes.description: Contains metadata settings related to video-on-demand ratings and legend keys.

classes.name: APAAssetsResponse
classes.description: Holds icon assets related to APA (probably a rating or branding system).

classes.name: VodRatingSettings
classes.description: Displays configuration for video-on-demand rating display timings.

classes.name: MediaItem
classes.description: Domain model representing a media entity with attributes like group ID, title, poster and background URLs, and ratings.

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Represents user rating details, including like value, stars, and timestamp.
